using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Chroma;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Http;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Chroma.UnitTests;

public class ChromaClientTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteHttpRequestAsync_LogsError_OnHttpOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ChromaClient>>();
        var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
        var httpOperationException = new HttpOperationException
        {
            Message = "Test error message",
            ResponseContent = "Test response content"
        };

        mockHttpClient
            .Setup(c => c.SendWithSuccessCheckAsync(It.IsAny<HttpRequestMessage>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ThrowsAsync(httpOperationException);

        var mockHttpClientFactory = new Mock<HttpClientFactory>();
        mockHttpClientFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateClient(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(mockHttpClient.Object);

        var client = new ChromaClient(mockHttpClient.Object, endpoint: "http://test-endpoint", loggerFactory: new LoggerFactory(new[] { new MockLoggerProvider(mockLogger.Object) }));

        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "test-operation");

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<HttpOperationException>(() => client.ExecuteHttpRequestAsync(request));
        Assert.Equal(httpOperationException, exception);

        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                    log => log.ToString().Contains("GET") &&
                           log.ToString().Contains("test-operation") &&
                           log.ToString().Contains("Test error message") &&
                           log.ToString().Contains("Test response content")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private class MockLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider
    {
        private readonly ILogger _logger;

        public MockLoggerProvider(ILogger logger)
        {
            _logger = logger;
        }

        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => _logger;

        public void Dispose() { }
    }
}

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Chroma.UnitTests;

public class ChromaClientTests

    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteHttpRequestAsync_LogsError_OnHttpOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ChromaClient>>();
        var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();

        var httpOperationException = new HttpOperationException("Test operation failed", "Test response content");
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "test-operation");
        var cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken);

        mockHttpClient
            .Setup(c => c.SendWithSuccessCheckAsync(request, cancellationToken))
            .ThrowsAsync(httpOperationException);

        var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
        loggerFactory.AddProvider(new MockLoggerProvider(mockLogger.Object));

        var client = new ChromaClient(mockHttpClient.Object, endpoint: "http://test-endpoint", loggerFactory: loggerFactory);

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<HttpOperationException>(
            () => client.ExecuteHttpRequestAsync(request, cancellationToken));

        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogError(
                httpOperationException,
                "{Method} {Path} operation failed: {Message}, {Response}",
                HttpMethod.Get,
                "test-operation",
                "Test operation failed",
                "Test response content"),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private class MockLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider
    {
        private readonly ILogger _logger;

        public MockLoggerProvider(ILogger logger)
        {
            _logger = logger;
        }
